statements.proposition: All of this change's implementations are backward compatible and follow existing fastero code patterns
statements.label: CANNOT_TELL
statements.note: Broad, unfalsifiable-by-one-check claim. New CLI flags (-p/--plain, --chart-title) add options without short-flag conflicts, but behaviour changed: warmup() replaced timeit(number=1) loop and now exec's setup/stmt, and new pre-compile checks exit early on syntax errors (including in setup). Whether any of this breaks existing users was not settled by a concrete check; 'follow existing patterns' is a style judgment.
